labels: Pongal came out dry and stiff

content.description: The finished pongal is thick, stiff and sliceable instead of soft and creamy, and it firms up further as it cools.
content.symptoms: Holds sharp edges; hard to stir; pasty rather than creamy on the tongue.
content.diagnosis: Not enough cooking liquid, or the mixture was cooked/held too long after the water was absorbed.
fixes: Stir in hot water a little at a time over low heat until it loosens to a soft dropping consistency, then fold in a spoon of extra ghee.
Serve immediately; pongal always thickens on standing.
prevention: Use about 4.5-5 cups water per 1 cup rice-plus-dal.
Take it off the heat while it still looks slightly loose.

root_causes: fast pressure release drying the surface
